 var(--line);border-radius:20px;padding:18px}
.enduring-card .num{font-size:.72rem;font-weight:900;letter-spacing:.08em;color:var(--accent2);text-transform:uppercase;margin-bottom:8px}
.enduring-card h4{font-size:1.05rem;margin:0 0 8px}
.enduring-card p{margin:0;color:var(--muted);font-size:.92rem}
.evolving-side{background:linear-gradient(145deg,#211416,#171a24);border:1px solid #4c2b2d;border-radius:28px;padding:26px;position:sticky;top:86px}
.evolving-side h3{font-size:1.55rem;margin:0 0 10px}
.evolving-side p{color:var(--muted);margin:0 0 16px}
.evolving-list{display:grid;gap:10px}
.evolving-item{border:1px solid #4c2b2d;border-radius:15px;padding:12px 13px;background:rgba(255,255,255,.02)}
.evolving-label{display:inline-block;padding:5px 8px;border-radius:999px;background:rgba(239,106,91,.12);color:var(--accent2);font-size:.68rem;text-transform:uppercase;letter-spacing:.07em;font-weight:900;margin-bottom:7px}
.foundation-note{margin-top:18px;padding:16px 18px;border-radius:18px;background:#10141d;border:1px solid var(--line);font-size:.94rem;color:var(--muted)}
.foundation-note b{color:var(--text)}
@media(max-width:900px){
  .enduring-wrap,.enduring-grid{grid-template-columns:1fr}
  .evolving-side{position:static}
}

</style>
</head>
